general.descripcion: Personal view of payslips by period and financial certificates.

general.estado_error: The source could not be reached

general.explicacion_error: The search failed. You can try again; sample data has not replaced the result.

general.sin_recibos: There are no payslips to show.

general.descarga_error: The document could not be downloaded.
